assessment.report:
# Repair-loop guard close assessment

Source 0.9.4 now contains the approved bounded instruction contract. Ordinary repair requires an evidence retrospective after two completed failures and human pause after three. Explicit user-requested or approved debugging allows six purposeful diagnostic rounds with a mid-review after three and an earlier pause after three consecutive completed rounds without useful evidence/narrowing. Repeated commands within one predeclared same-hypothesis experiment count once on completion; independent hypotheses cannot be bundled or available results kept open. Evidence narrows only the stall streak, not total budgets or prior repair history.

The Lead inspected the canonical contract, changed Skill routes, shared records/handoffs and actual public-language diffs. Pause reports distinguish observations from ranked causes and identify precise minimal human inputs, causal mechanisms/confidence, bounded options and preserved state. Identity follows acceptance behavior/conditions/deviation; recurrences and missing history do not reset counts. Debug permission is separate from repair permission. Healthy long work uses observable task checkpoints, not universal elapsed limits. Both review findings are factual consistency corrections, resolved in actual files and independently rechecked; no new user design choice was inferred.

The existing source layout remains adequate: one canonical shared reference, workflow pointers and minimal fields in existing records. No new Blueprint, restructuring, PRD authority, OpenSpec enablement, runtime evaluator or model setting is introduced. Patch version 0.9.4 extends existing execution behavior, not a stable promotion. Complete public pairs and their changed facts/caveats were reviewed; historical release content is preserved and private absolute paths are absent from changed publishable records. Other inventoried documents and prior tasks are preserved, not re-certified. This fresh assessment follows final source/packet impact review; it does not refresh unrelated scopes to make them green.

Tester recorded passing native/docs checks plus isolated bilingual, package, fake-home installation, documentation and stage suites with owned fixture cleanup. Actual installer all-file SHA256/receipt assertions include the new reference at version 0.9.4. Independent Reviewer found no remaining material source issue after two corrections. These checks do not prove future Agent stopping, real E2E or user acceptance; RG-01–RG-14 remain manual pending. The optional skill-creator quick validator failed before validation because PyYAML is unavailable; no dependency was installed, and existing native resource/discovery checks provide actual compatibility evidence rather than claiming optional-check success. The only script edit is its declarative Kit version stamp, not runtime behavior; existing overview is adequate and recording regressions pass.

Actual selected implementation writer is team-docs-maintainer /root/repair_guard_writer_v2; original named Tester and Reviewer were reused at /root/concurrency_tester and /root/concurrency_reviewer. Earlier unknown-selector preflight children were read-only, not reclassified as writers; rejected capacity attempts returned no ID. Loaded role/model/effort metadata are unconfirmed. Invocation and exact written Skill section evidence are in the active packet. No children recursively delegated, real installation/global setting changed, Git write occurred, external service called, or ECC content accessed. Current task source/readiness work is complete subject to explicitly pending live-workflow acceptance.
